results.title: US-open 60-min range breakout
results.rules: Opening range = the first 60 minutes from the NYSE open (13:30 UTC in US summer time, 14:30 in winter), weekdays only. Rest buy-stop and sell-stop orders at the two range edges; the first one touched is the trade, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the far side of the range, a limit target at 3.0x the risk; exit at the NYSE close. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.
